_readme: Markers for the Map of Eryndor page. Coordinates are pixels on the full-size source image (10240 x 5760).
To find coordinates: open the map page, press the 'Coordinates' button, click a spot (or a numbered unnamed dot), and paste the copied snippet below.
Fields: name (shown on the map), type (region | capital | city | town | village | landmark), x, y.

Optional: nation (shown in the popup), blurb (one sentence in the popup), page (lore page title, or /slug, if it differs from name), minZoom / maxZoom (override the zoom range in which this marker shows).
Links are resolved automatically by matching 'page' (or 'name') against lore page titles.

'types' sets the zoom range for each kind of marker. Fully zoomed out is about zoom 1 on a desktop; each +1 doubles the scale. Nations show up to 2.25, capitals and cities from 2.5 (so the two never overlap), towns from 3, villages from 4.
